records.title: A blitz of bends: decompression sickness in four students after hypobaric chamber training.
records.evidence_note: Four of nine students on the affected flight presented the next morning. Three diagnoses were Type II and one was Type I. Observer attendance and outcomes are unavailable. The paper also describes a wider HALO profile margin of 14.9% (4/27) with overlapping cases and does not specify the profile denominator by role. The printed percentage is retained as reported.

observations.note: Attendance on the case-selected flight. The same four cases appear in the broader profile summary.

note: Public publisher PDF. Verified Introduction, p. 1097, Methods and Results, p. 1098, and reference 3, p. 1101.

records.title: Decompression sickness incidence over 63 months of hypobaric chamber operation.
records.evidence_note: The four early-1985 student diagnoses prompted review of chamber surveillance. The paper cites the separate case report as reference 3 and explicitly excludes all specialized HALO profile exposures and their DCS cases from the standard-profile incidence calculations. Existing Table I counts are held in the benchmark archive.
